provenance.asset_description: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-15: Within Antiquated Halls: The background art is of Zarta Dralneenm dressed in a smart red jacket, as she moves pieces around a battle map while her wayfinder illuminates the scene, with Pathfinders and Andoren soldiers moving in the background of a busy war camp. The overlaying art is of a tall, worn, statue of a human with a large insect on their shoulder.
